biw_news.title: Novelis and Maxion Engineer Advanced Aluminum Battery Housing for Commercial EVs
biw_news.summary: Novelis and Maxion Structural Components have jointly engineered a specialized aluminum battery housing tailored for commercial electric vehicles. The design leverages advanced aluminum rolling and structural stamping techniques to optimize crash safety and payload capacity while minimizing weight.

biw_news.title: Leapmotor Debuts CTC 3.0 Cell-to-Chassis Architecture with High-Low Fusion Integration
biw_news.summary: Leapmotor has introduced its next-generation CTC 3.0 High-Low Fusion Battery system integrated directly into the vehicle architecture. This cell-to-chassis design eliminates traditional subframe boundaries, drastically improving torsional rigidity and structural integration.

biw_news.title: Hydro and Siemens Mobility Pioneer Closed-Loop Structural Aluminum Recycling for Rail and Automotive
biw_news.summary: Through the Train2Train initiative, Hydro and Siemens Mobility are scaling up processes to remelt structural aluminum recovered from decommissioned transport applications into high-grade automotive and rail extrusions. The project proves the feasibility of maintaining strict metallurgical and mechanical property standards using recycled automotive-grade alloys.

biw_news.title: Laserax Acquires SLCR Lasertechnik to Expand Advanced Laser Surface Treatment for Joining Technologies
biw_news.summary: Laserax has acquired a majority stake in SLCR Lasertechnik, augmenting its portfolio of specialized laser systems for surface preparation. This technology plays a critical role in pre-treatment processes required for high-integrity structural bonding, laser welding, and mechanical joining of lightweight mixed-materials in the body shop.

biw_news.title: Advancements in Tailored Thermoplastic Composite Ribs for Lightweight Aircraft and Automotive Wing Structures
biw_news.summary: Recent demonstrations of direct stamping and infrared welding on 64-ply thermoplastic composite rib structures highlight significant mass reductions over traditional aluminum frameworks. These high-rate manufacturing methods offer immense potential for future lightweight load-bearing automotive spaceframes and crash structures.

biw_news.title: Rolls-Royce Puts Project Nightingale Body Structure and Cashmere Roof Assembly Through Extreme Thermal Testing
biw_news.summary: Rolls-Royce is subjecting the body structure and interior assemblies of Project Nightingale to punishing thermal validation, testing material durability up to 176°F. The rigorous testing cycle also includes structural fatigue evaluations via 15,000 trunk-slamming iterations to ensure long-term body joint integrity.
